title: ∫ div_M Y_k dμ_V → ∫ div_M X dμ_V when DY_k → DX uniformly with supports in a fixed compact set
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, E = Ambient n ℓ, V a rectifiable n-varifold in E with weight μ = μ_V, and suppose μ is finite on compact sets and x ↦ p_x = (T_xV).starProjection is μ-a.e. strongly measurable. Let K ⊆ E be compact, X : E → E a C¹ map with tsupport X ⊆ K, and Y_k : E → E (k ∈ ℕ) C¹ maps with tsupport Y_k ⊆ K, such that DY_k → DX uniformly on E. Then ∫ div_M Y_k dμ → ∫ div_M X dμ, where div_M Z(x) = V.tangentialDiv Z x = trace(DZ(x) ∘ p_x).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (K : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (X : Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (Y : ℕ → Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ (V.tangentSpace x).starProjection) V.weight → IsCompact K → ContDiff ℝ 1 X → tsupport X ⊆ K → (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Y k) ∧ tsupport (Y k) ⊆ K) → TendstoUniformly (fun k ↦ fderiv ℝ (Y k)) (fderiv ℝ X) atTop → Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫ x, V.tangentialDiv (Y k) x ∂V.weight) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, V.tangentialDiv X x ∂V.weight))
